Title: Manoj's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Manoj - 36 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Shalini - 28 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The metro platform - a shining floor, a display board

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Let's do something fun today."

[Manoj sips red wine.]

Shalini: "This is amazing!"

[Manoj wraps a bandage around his bleeding hand.]

Manoj: "Show me too!"

[Manoj's phone dies in the middle of the call.]

Shalini: "Okay, Manoj."

[Manoj jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Manoj: "And then?"

[Manoj coughs in the thick smoke and crawls to the door.]

Shalini: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The metro platform - Day

[Manoj stands on the platform. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[Manoj runs to catch the train.]

Manoj: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Manoj is pushed in the crowd and nearly falls.]

Manoj (excited): "Yes, all right."

[Manoj offers his seat to an old woman.]

Manoj (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
